name: Square Face Class
definition: For a square with cyclically ordered vertices $1,2,3,4$, take $\mathcal H_{\square}=\{\varnothing,1,2,3,4,12,23,34,14,1234\}$.
properties: This is the face class of a two-dimensional polytope. Its one-inclusion graph has the full face $1234$ as an isolated vertex, so it is not a partial cube. Projection to $\{1,2,3\}$ contains $123$ but not $13$, and conditioning coordinate 1 to one contains $234$ but not the singleton $3$; neither output can be the full face family of a polyhedral complex.
